title: Wolf and Choir
author: Odile Iversen
blurb: Noor Iversen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
